intro: Free movement using an internal passport, a shared labour market, and Russian as an official language. The High-Tech Park (HTP) offers a 9% tax benefit for IT residents.
climate: Temperate continental: mild snowy winters around -3°C, warm humid summers around +20°C. Grey overcast shoulder seasons for much of the year.
mentality: A calm, deliberate pace. A strong culture of order and cleanliness, with a low level of everyday crime.
language_note: Two official languages — Russian and Belarusian. In daily life Russian is used everywhere, without an accent.
visa_note: Russian citizens enter using an internal passport. Registration is required after 90 days of residence. Residence permit via employment, business or marriage.
